title: Verified Snapshot To Worktree Diff Contract
summary: Report profile-owned unpublished source drift against one integrity-verified Shin snapshot without Git, rebuilding the index, or interpreting product semantics.

release.compatibility: Shin v1.25 requires an explicit generator-v17 rebuild for corrected authority semantics. No compatibility reader or implicit migration is retained.

baseline.source: The active out-dir manifest and its declared generated files.
baseline.integrity: load_verified_snapshot validates layout, publication state, manifest metadata, output declarations, file hashes, byte counts, and undeclared generated entries before comparison.
baseline.profileRule: The baseline profile id must equal the active profile id. A mismatch fails as configuration error rather than producing an ambiguous diff.

worktree.scope: Only paths selected by the active profile document and source-fact policies are enumerated. Relevant untracked files are included; excluded paths remain outside the result.
worktree.documents: Current document inputs are compared by canonical relative path, exact content hash, and byte count.
worktree.sourceFacts: Current source-fact inputs are compared by canonical relative path, scan status, exact content hash when scanned, and byte count.
worktree.identity: worktree_id is a deterministic FNV-1a-64 identity over profile id, profile config hash, bounded source-fact inventory counts, and the sorted current input inventory. It is not cryptographic authentication.
worktree.concurrency: After hashing, both configured inventories and every observed file metadata tuple are checked again. Concurrent mutation fails closed instead of publishing a mixed observation.

comparison.rule: The command reports exact input drift. A move may appear as remove plus add, and textual drift is not interpreted as a behavioral or architectural change.

result.current: True only when metadata, document inputs, source-fact inputs, and bounded source-fact inventory counts match the verified baseline.
result.soft: Without --strict, verified drift returns exit 0 with ok=false and current=false.
result.strict: With --strict, verified drift returns exit 1 with the same complete result document.
result.details: One deterministic global detail budget covers every category. Each source detail exposes baseline and worktree hash, bytes, and source-fact status when applicable.
result.detailsOmitted: Exact counted changes not emitted after the global detail limit.

limits.snapshotLimits: The existing verified-snapshot byte, file-count, and integrity-table limits apply.
limits.sourceLimits: The active profile source-fact file-count and file-size bounds apply unchanged.

agentUse.normal: Run after opening a verified index when active implementation work may have changed the repository since publication.
agentUse.interpretation: Use details as a bounded list of unpublished paths, then open those source files directly. Do not treat worktree_id as a replacement snapshot or retrieval receipt.
agentUse.rebuildBoundary: Use build and normal strict gates when the changed worktree itself must become retrievable. worktree-diff never patches or overlays generated rows.

verification: unchanged worktree produces byte-identical current results
document edit, source-fact edit, addition, and removal
profile mismatch and unsupported option rejection
nonGoals: no Git status, commit, branch, or ignore-file interpretation
no incremental generated index or query overlay
no semantic diff or conflict report
no daemon, filesystem watcher, MCP transport, or background process
no source mutation, repair, or publication
